Apple is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Reasonable Accommodation and Drug Free Workplace policy Learn more (Opens in a new window) . Apple is a drug-free workplace. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.description: Skip to main content Login Start Your Tax Return Private Self-Employed Why Taxfix Taxes in Germany Login Start Your Tax Return Careers at Taxfix Fixing taxes is just the start. We’re empowering everyone to achieve true financial well-being. Our compassionate, curious team asks the right questions, solves tough problems, and keeps learning. Join us to build a future where financial well-being is for everyone. See our open roles Our Growth Journey Ready to make history with us? Join now and shape what’s next. 2016 Taxfix is founded, aiming to simplify tax filing. 2018 50+ employees and 100K filed tax returns. 2020 Series C raised, expanding into new markets and accelerating product development. 2021 Surpassed 1M filed tax returns worldwide + 5-year anniversary festival. 2022 Over 1B refunded to users, New Berlin office opens, & Madrid office opens. 2023 Taxfix & Steurbot join forces, Assisted product launches in Spain and Italy. 2024 4B milestone in Germany, Taxfix & TaxScouts join forces, New Taxfix Brand identity launches, assisted product available in Spain. 2025 TaxScouts rebrands to Taxfix. Our Values Our values are more than words - they show up in how we work, collaborate, and grow together. Whether we’re solving complex problems, supporting one another, or challenging the status quo, we lead with empathy, curiosity, and purpose. 01 Understand We show curiosity and are not afraid to challenge the status quo. We use understanding to drive for quicker execution. We push for greater customer understanding and empathy. We take the time to understand the ‘why’ with our colleagues. 02 Deliver We make things happen and drive for results. We rigorously prioritise and keep our focus. We figure out how to unblock blockers. We don’t need to be perfect, we get stuff done. 03 Develop We support you in your personal and professional growth. We value accountability and stepping up. We each drive and determine our own journey. We have humility and know that we never stop learning. 04 Trust We assume good intent. We hold each other accountable for our scope. We give each other space to do the right thing. We know every productive conversation goes two ways. Leadership at Taxfix Get to know the authentic, mission-driven leaders who bring their whole selves to work, foster trust, and unite around making taxes simpler for everyone. See our open roles Our Culture Be yourself We celebrate individuality and diversity. At Taxfix, you can bring your whole self to work and know your voice matters. Transform Together Collaboration is our superpower. By working side by side, we amplify our impact and unlock new possibilities. Fix Finance for All Our mission drives us. We’re making finance more accessible, fair, and simple for everyone. How we hire While our hiring process may vary slightly depending on location or role, every candidate can expect the same core experience and key steps along the way. Our Talent Acquisition team carefully reviews your application to assess your experience, skills, and alignment with the role. Application Review A 30–45 minute call to get to know you and give you space to ask about the role, team, or life at Taxfix. Talent Acquisition Interview Deep dive into your experience, working style, and what excites you about joining us. Hiring Manager Interview Depending on the role, this might be a task, case, or coding challenge to see how you approach real work. Skill Assessment Interview A chat with a Cultural Ambassador to explore collaboration, values, and cross-functional fit. Cultural Fit Interview For leadership roles, this is a conversation with senior leaders about how you lead, grow others, and contribute to culture. Leadership Interview If it’s a match, we’ll be excited to make it official! Offer Our Talent Acquisition team carefully reviews your application to assess your experience, skills, and alignment with the role. jobs.title: Skip the line
jobs.description: # Building different Shopify is where contradictions create magic. We move with startup speed, but we’ve been around for a minute. We're technical to our core and human in our approach. We're deeply serious and seriously playful, because we know that's how the best work gets done. We give a shit and get shit done. We obsess over problems, and build out loud. We build in hard mode. From the founder in the code to the engineers who move like entrepreneurs. Hack it, break it, make it better. It’s about high agency in high ambiguity. Often starting scrappy, but always shipping polished. This environment transforms people. We raise the floor, while we constantly redefine the ceiling. The bar is high and the pace is fast, but nobody climbs alone. That's how we create extraordinary products for our merchants. That’s how we make commerce better for everyone. Ready to join? Let's go. Already built something the world knows? Skip the line. Let's go Skip the line

jobs.title: Our rotation program
jobs.description: A different approach for a diverse team We believe that learning is a lifelong journey. When you join WiseTech's product development team, your first 26 weeks are dedicated to new-starter rotations within our technical team. Our program guides you through three rotations before you settle into a regular team. This gives you the chance to acquire skills and gain experience in various product focus areas, allowing you to discover the best fit for you. We give you control and encourage you to shape your career. You'll have the chance to pick your preferred teams for rotations two and three. You'll also get to know our team, culture, and explore different teams, technologies, and business areas, guided by a new mentor in each rotation. Our rotation program

jobs.title: Learn more
jobs.description: Life at WiseTech Global We’re an engineer-founded and led tech company, with research and development at the core of what we do. We build technology that makes a difference to the world we live in. We are truly, deeply, passionate about what we do and we use all of our empathy, energy, focus, courage, talent, drive and logic to confront the really big stuff that others will not. We have a range of benefits including generous leave, flexible working, development opportunities, employee assistance programs, remote working allowance, and more. Learn more

FAQs & support Ready to start your future with us, but you still have a few questions? We’ve got you covered. We’ve compiled answers to a range of questions, from how to apply to how to further your career once you’re on board. Life at Siemens People at Siemens are thinkers, visionaries, and doers. Not only do they have a passion for disruptive ideas – they also have the courage to bring them to life. Get to know them.
